I didn't come here to fight! I came here to hack at you violently! - Toushirou Hitsugaya,Bleach

We are all like fireworks. We climb, shine, and always go our separate ways and become further apart. But even if that time comes, let's not disappear like a firework. Let's continue to shine... Forever. - Toushirou Hitsugaya,Bleach

Stand back? [To Kira after Gin asked him to stand back] No, Kira...Run. Run until you're out of my sight, and keep running. Otherwise...I can't guarantee you won't get dragged into this and be killed. - Toushirou Hitsugaya,Bleach
I'M﻿ NOT AN ELEMENTARY STUDENT!!! - Toushirou Hitsugaya,Bleach
Aizen, I will kill you. - Toushirou Hitsugaya,Bleach
Don't come back... "Bed-wetter" Momo. - Toushirou Hitsugaya,Bleach

Dummy. I'm not gonna dwell on what happened forever. All that junk... it's the furthest thing on my mind. You should especially quit worrying about it and get some more sleep. Hurry up and get rid of your Panda eyes, got it? - Toushirou Hitsugaya,Bleach
No, not yet, now that you've made me this serious. Regret as much as you damn well want!! - Toushirou Hitsugaya,Bleach
[to Gin Ichimaru] If you make Hinamori shed even one drop of blood, I'll kill you. - Toushirou Hitsugaya,Bleach
Sit upon the frozen heavens! Hyōrinmaru!! - Toushirou Hitsugaya,Bleach

Seek not beauty in battle. Seek not beauty in death. Consider not your own life. If you wish to protect that which must be protected, then strike while your opponent's back is turned. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach

All creatures want to believe in something bigger than themselves. They cannot live without blind obedience. And to escape the pressure of that trust, those in whom faith is placed in turn look for someone higher than themselves. And then those people in turn look for someone even stronger. That is how all Kings are born. That is how all Gods are born. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach
Trusting someone...means relying on them and only the weak do that. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach

I never ask them to trust me at all. I told them to come with me but I never told them to trust me. And I always tell them not to trust anyone, including myself. But sadly, there are not many strong enough to do that. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach
[To Barragan, before he was recruited by Aizen] Isn't it ironic, king of Hueco Mundo? Dressed in black and poised to attack, you look just like a shinigami. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach

[To Orihime, after she had being taken from Ichigo once again] A girl like you should smile more often. Overcast skies blot out the sun, and that always brings people's spirits down. So why not let the sun shine...For just a while longer? - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach
No matter what may happen... As long as you walk by my side... There shall be no enemy that can stand before us. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach
Good evening, Espada. There has been an enemy attack. But first...Let us brew some tea. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach
[After Gin offers to kill some Arrancars] No thanks, for that would be boring. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach
Oh? I thought I severed your body from the waist-down, but...It seems the cut was too shallow. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach
In my eyes, there is no difference between wiping away one speck of dust or two. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach
"No longer the Aizen you know," hm...? I'm afraid you've been deluded, Abarai-kun...The 'Aizen Sousuke' you knew never existed to begin with. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach
It's very difficult for me to step on an ant without crushing it. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach
Don't use such strong words -- It makes your weakness all the more apparent. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach
I had no intention of deceiving anyone. It's just that none of you could understand...My true self. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach

[To Hitsugaya, after stabbing Hinamori] Aww...You found her. Sorry, I didn't want you to find out this way...No. I should have chopped her into little pieces and hidden them away where you would never find them. - Aizen Sousuke,Bleach
I've liked him for so long. So long. But Mayama likes someone else. But I wanna hear his voice. I want to hold his hand. I feel like this. - Ayumi Yamada,Honey and Clover

Never once did I say it.  But just as he knew my feelings and couldn't return them. She will probably realize his and probably his heart wouldn't have a chance either? When I think about things like that, my tears won't stop. - Ayumi Yamada,Honey and Clover
I'll show you a real assassination. No... Maybe you won't even be able to see it. - Soi Fon,Bleach

I thought I told you. If you see your allies losing, that's your chance. Don't step between them. Take the enemy down from behind. And if the enemy's so strong, you can't even do that, then just watch your allies get killed. That's what it means to be Special Forces. - Soi Fon,Bleach

Of my five older siblings, two died on the first mission, then two more on the second. Then on the sixth mission, the last one... Died as well. I felt sad, somewhat, but more than that, I felt ashamed of their incompetence. - Soi Fon,Bleach
I'm inadequate in everything. - Soi Fon,Bleach
Such words are wasted on someone like me. - Soi Fon,Bleach
Showing your back in a battle? You've become a fool Yoruichi! - Soi Fon,Bleach
You know the power of my zanpakuto, Suzumebachi. If someone gets hit twice in the same spot... They die! - Soi Fon,Bleach
The one hundred years we were apart were meant to bring me power and make you weak! Yoruichi! - Soi Fon,Bleach
Why didn't you take me with you!? Yoruichi? - Soi Fon,Bleach

Only underlings get caught up in the matter of style and lose the battle. A captain can't afford such indulgences. Don't try to be a good kid. Whether you own somebody or they own you. The moment you start a fight, you are wrong in either way. - Shunsui Kyōraku,Bleach
[To Starrk, about Lilynette] That child with you... Can you send her somewhere else? I can't really go all out with her there. - Shunsui Kyōraku,Bleach
Why so cold, Nanao-chan? - Shunsui Kyōraku,Bleach
Do we really have to fight, Yama-jii? - Shunsui Kyōraku,Bleach
I placed this blade of grass in my mouth thinking I'd look cool. But it must be poison 'cause ith makinth ma mouth numb. - Shunsui Kyōraku,Bleach
Cute, cute Nanao-chaaaan. Lovely, lovely Nanao -- AHHHHHHH!!!! - Shunsui Kyōraku,Bleach
Nanao-chan is last place! - Shunsui Kyōraku,Bleach
Flowers are disturbed, god of flowers weeps, winds of Heaven are disturbed, demon of Heaven laughs. Katen Kyōkotsu! - Shunsui Kyōraku,Bleach

I was glad you did not pretend to be a saint and claim to love the world despite everything. That is why I decided that I would be your true friend. I would accept your sorrow. And I would share my joy. If you strayed I would reprimand you. If you made mistakes, I would forgive you. And when you found yourself in trouble, I would be there for you. So that you who learn to hate the world, would come to love it once more. - Komamura Sajin,Bleach
Back then. I felt a kernel of untruth in your words. You talked about "The world she loves" many times. But made not a single mention of "The world I love". - Komamura Sajin,Bleach
You destroyed those Menos Grandes. That's enough for me! I have decided to fight by your side! I won't accept no as an answer, masked ones! - Komamura Sajin,Bleach
You are right. I have not yet introduced myself. I am Captain of the Seventh Division Komamura Sajin. And though it shames me, I am just as you say -- A meager worm of a man. - Komamura Sajin,Bleach
[to Choe Neng Poww, as the giant Arrancar charges a Cero after making a comment on Komamura's strength] I see...Then I shall stop that yawn in its tracks. Bankai. - Komamura Sajin,Bleach
Don't retreat, Tetsuzaemon. No matter what. You stand firm right behind me! - Komamura Sajin,Bleach
[thinking at the grave of Tosen's friend] O' anonymous friend of Tousen... If you had been there...What would you have said to stop him? - Komamura Sajin,Bleach
Let us commence, Zaraki! Your favorite game of carnage!! - Komamura Sajin,Bleach

[during Tosen, Gin Ichimaru and Sosuke Aizen's escape from Soul Society] Get down here, Tosen! Why did you become a Shingami? Was it not for your deceased friend? Was it not to carry out justice!? Where is your justice now!? - Komamura Sajin,Bleach
[holds up juice box] How do you drink from this? - Rukia Kuchiki,Bleach
You can see me? Rather, you kicked me... - Rukia Kuchiki,Bleach
I see. I feel a strong pulse. - Rukia Kuchiki,Bleach
Have you been out on the window ledge all this time, in plain sight? What if the neighbors report a silver haired elementary student burglar? - Abarai Renji,Bleach
I already told you...you can't kill me with that sword anymore! - Abarai Renji,Bleach
If you wanna talk to me, do it while I cut you to pieces. But, I'm not gonna hold back one bit! Bankai! - Abarai Renji,Bleach

Don't just blame yourself. You're not tough enough to withstand everything. Split the load, to my shoulders, and to Ichigo's. Just stack it little by little. That's why we've become stronger. Believe in him, Rukia. - Abarai Renji,Bleach

I've always been afraid...Always been pretending to follow you closely, always pretending to sharpen my fangs, when the truth is...I'm scared to death just treading on your shadow. - Abarai Renji,Bleach
I shall light a fire upon the fang that falls short, so that I needn't see that star...So that it shall not tear this throat of mine. - Abarai Renji,Bleach
Ichigo...I know this is shameful, but I'm begging you -- Rukia...Please save Rukia!! - Abarai Renji,Bleach
The stray dog in me is dyed into my bones... All I do is howl at the moon, but I don't have the guts to bite... - Abarai Renji,Bleach
Howl, Zabimaru. - Abarai Renji,Bleach
I knew it. You can't even ask your own zanpakutō its name. - Abarai Renji,Bleach
You're just an overnight shinigami. You couldn't put one scratch on us real ones. - Abarai Renji,Bleach
*to Ichigo* So you're the human who got his powers from Rukia? - Abarai Renji,Bleach
I'll tattle-tale to Yachiru if you keep that up, Ikkaku! - Matsumoto Rangiku,Bleach
I don't know if you noticed, but you just called him "Captain." - Matsumoto Rangiku,Bleach
I hate talkative guys... They gross me out. - Matsumoto Rangiku,Bleach
Growl, Haineko! - Matsumoto Rangiku,Bleach
[Rangiku steps out of the bath naked to comfort a crying Orihime] There, there! Cry, cry, you poor thing. Drown all of your sorrows in my chest! - Matsumoto Rangiku,Bleach
[to Momo on Aizen's final letter] As a vice-captain, I think it's a great honor to be the receiver of her captain's final words. Read it well. - Matsumoto Rangiku,Bleach

[thinking as Nel tells her to cheer for Ichigo] That's right. To begin with, I came here just thinking I wanted to protect everyone. But when I heard they had come to save me, I couldn't help but feel a little glad, just a bit in my heart. When I look at Kurosaki-kun in that mask, I think that he might not have come here to save me at all. Even though it's wrong, they shouldn't be going that far for me. - Inoue Orihime,Bleach

Kurosaki-kun... I'm weak, so it's always like I turn back to look to you for help. But now I won't turn back and I'll go forward. The next time we meet I won't look to you for help, Kurosaki-kun, I'll be able to fight on my own. - Inoue Orihime,Bleach
We don't look any different from those shinigami. We just dress diferently. - Inoue Orihime,Bleach

It's just that... It's just that not being able to fight with everyone makes me feel lonely...!! But what would make me feel worse than being lonely is getting in everyone's way... that would make me feel worse!! If it means getting in the way of Kurosaki-kun and everyone... then I would rather be lonely, very lonely. - Inoue Orihime,Bleach

I'm a terrible person, aren't I? "If only Kurosaki-kun would cheer up, I'd be happy." At least, I thought that was how I felt. Then Kuchiki-san came back and cheered Kurosaki-kun up. I should have been really happy, but... but... [starts to cry] but instead I'm jealous of Kuchiki-san! - Inoue Orihime,Bleach
If I were the rain, that binds together the heavens and the earth, whom in all eternity will never mingle, would I be able to bind two hearts together? - Inoue Orihime,Bleach

[to Nemu about Uryuu. Nemu is currently attempting to restrain Uryuu so Mayruri can heal him, but she is unknowingly smothering him with her breasts] Yes, Nemu. Just smother him with those things. Worst case, he dies happy. - Kurotsuchi Mayuri,Bleach

[to Szayel Aporro Grantz] Immaculate being... Was it? In this secular existence, perfection is an illusion, regardless of those who utter the contrary. This is the reality. Common man seeks it out, they strive to achieve it, as if it were some tangible thing... But... The fact of the matter is, perfection is a hollow shell. It is devoid of any substance. I spit on perfection. Perfection, after all, implies you've reached the summit. No trial and error, no ability to conceptualize. An omniscient being would have no need for such superfluous things... Am I making myself clear? For people who dabble in the sciences, such as ourselves, perfection would make us obsolete. Many magnificent things have been, and will continue to come into existence... And yet every last one of them will fall short of perfection's finish. Our function as men of science relies on their many shortcomings. Then, and only then, can we apply the fruits of our labor. To put it simply... As soon as you began spouting that nonsense about being an immaculate being... your fate was sealed. How dare you call yourself a man of science? - Kurotsuchi Mayuri,Bleach
[upon arriving at Szayel Aporro Grantz's location] Arrancar, Arrancar, Arrancar... Espada! Hueco Mundo is quite the treasure trove. - Kurotsuchi Mayuri,Bleach

Oh, you know what I'm talking about. That stupid line that all you Quincies keep saying up until the moment you die. By the honor of the Quincy I cannot do this, by the honor of the Quincy I won't allow that. Quincy this, Quincy that! Every last one of you! It's so annoying! - Kurotsuchi Mayuri,Bleach
Killing you now will be as easy as strangling a baby. - Kurotsuchi Mayuri,Bleach
A grenade that's thrown should not come back. - Kurotsuchi Mayuri,Bleach

[to Chad and Orihime] Your transformation is not a disease. You were just given the key to the door in front of you. There's no need to know the cause. No need for sorrow or sadness. What comes next is up to you. You can use your keys to open the door...or lock it tight. And if you do choose to open it... You can still decide not to pass through. - Urahara Kisuke,Bleach
Awaken, Benihime. - Urahara Kisuke,Bleach
[Singing to Yammy] Aizen-sama will get maaaad at youuuu! - Urahara Kisuke,Bleach
Oh, it IS a chore. Risking your life and keeping busy are all the same! - Urahara Kisuke,Bleach
Noooo, there's no way I, a mere handsome and sexy shopkeeper, could possibly have bankai! - Urahara Kisuke,Bleach
[To Yoruichi] It's alright! Kurosaki-san's potential is greater than mine! - Urahara Kisuke,Bleach

[Sees Yoruichi in cat form] Yes! It's Yoruichi! You've come back! Ha ha ha!! [Picks her up] Come here you little devil, let me take a look at you! You're my fuzzy little troublemaker, yes you are! Now who's your daddy? Hmm? - Urahara Kisuke,Bleach
I'll drive you into a corner and make you remember that attack. - Urahara Kisuke,Bleach

[Urahara writes Ichigo a message in blood] Please meet at Urahara shop immediately. [After Ichigo freaked out] P.S: If you look at this message and think that it is the message of a person before his death... then you have no sense of humor. - Urahara Kisuke,Bleach
A warrior who has lost his ability to fight is only going to be in the way. - Urahara Kisuke,Bleach
Lately, I've been looking at these two guys only. As expected, I see flowers when there are women in the workplace... the atmosphere! - Urahara Kisuke,Bleach

[In his Resurrección form] I can see! I can see! I can see!!! So this is the sky!! So this is blood!! So this is the world!! ...So this is what you look like. Komamura. You are uglier... than I thought. - Tousen Kaname,Bleach
[to Hisagi after stabbing him] I am afraid. Then and now, my fear has always been that I would die a shinigami like you. - Tousen Kaname,Bleach
[to Komamura] Don't make me laugh. Aizen-sama has given me something far more powerful than a bankai. - Tousen Kaname,Bleach
[to Hisagi] Open my eyes? You? Open my eyes? You never change. - Tousen Kaname,Bleach
[after Hisagi thanks him] Aren't you clever? Is that supposed to be sarcastic? - Tousen Kaname,Bleach
I knew it would. Someday we would cross swords and one of us will die. - Tousen Kaname,Bleach
It must make you sick to know an underling like me is going to kill you. - Tousen Kaname,Bleach
I was trying to chop off your head from the eye up. A little scratch counts as a miss. - Tousen Kaname,Bleach
Justice without a great cause begets nothing more than slaughter. That same slaughter in a great cause...Is Justice. - Tousen Kaname,Bleach

I told you before, Komamura. The only paths that I see with these eyes are the ones not dyed with blood. Those paths are the paths to justice. So whichever path I choose...Is justice. - Tousen Kaname,Bleach

If it's not enough to believe in justice, then I will become justice. I will seek out all evil in this world and wipe them out like the clouds in the sky. I swear I will...For justice. - Tousen Kaname,Bleach
[about his deceased friend] I never overcame my shyness and told her that I actually liked clouds. - Tousen Kaname,Bleach

[to Kenpachi Zaraki, after Tosen's senses-robbing Bankai still does not discourage the Eleventh Division Captain from fighting] I see. It's understandable. You are a demon. You belong in the darkness. So of course you do not fear it. - Tousen Kaname,Bleach
I do not hate you. However, to protect our peaceful existence, there is no other way! - Tousen Kaname,Bleach
[to Kenpachi Zaraki] I did not say that I hate you. What I mean to say is that you are unforgivable!! - Tousen Kaname,Bleach

When we die, our bodies disintegrate and become part of the reishi that make up Soul Society. And when that time comes...where does your heart go? It gets passed on to your nakama (comrades). If you pass it on to them, then your heart will always live on within them. Kuchiki, that's why...you must never, ever, ever die alone. Got it, Kuchiki? - Shiba Kaien,Bleach
Whenever you fight from this point on, there is one thing you must never do. Which is...to die alone. - Shiba Kaien,Bleach

Every time you and I interact...a bit of "heart" is born between us. Heart isn't something inside you. But whenever you think, whenever you remember someone, that's when heart is born. I mean, if you were the only one alive in the whole world, heart wouldn't exist, now would it? - Shiba Kaien,Bleach

The fight to protect life and the fight to protect honor——that's Captain Ukitake's policy. But you know, Kuchiki...I think that in the end, those both end up being the same thing. ...Heart. - Shiba Kaien,Bleach
[when Rukia asks why she is in the Gotei 13] What the hell?! That's so obvious! To "fight" and to "protect"! - Shiba Kaien,Bleach
[dying] Kuchiki, I dragged you into this...I'm sorry. You must've been scared. Thanks, Kuchiki. Thanks to you...I can leave my heart here. - Shiba Kaien,Bleach

[possessed by a Hollow] Why do you keep calling my name so? Are you that worried about me? Are you that much in love with me, little girl? If you love me so much...I'll eat you first! - Shiba Kaien,Bleach
Uncoil the seas and heavens, Nejibana! - Shiba Kaien,Bleach
But don't forget... as long as you're in my division, I'm on your side until death and beyond. - Shiba Kaien,Bleach
The Commander-General's rather violent today, wouldn't you say? - Ukitake Jyuushirou,Bleach

If you were in this situation, what would you have done? You would run after Byakuya...And then kick him in the butt, right? No matter how one captain complains, the Central Government won't change their decision for one person. But if it was you, you would still run around appealing to save Kuchiki...No. You would probably do something completely different. You always chose the path that lead to the most danger. Am I right...Kaien? - Ukitake Jyuushirou,Bleach
My, my. So dangerous. - Ukitake Jyuushirou,Bleach

If you save Kaien, then what becomes of his pride? If you go to his aid now, his life will be saved. But... at the same time, it would end up killing his pride for all eternity. - Ukitake Jyuushirou,Bleach
All waves, rise now and become my shield, lightning, strike now and become my blade! Sōgyo no Kotowari! - Ukitake Jyuushirou,Bleach
You may be able to save us. If you stay and protect us. But what's good is that everyone else dies! Please go!! Captain Komamura!!! - Kira Izuru,Bleach

It increases the weight of whatever it hits, until my opponent can no longer bear the weight and falls to the ground. And then they bow their head as if in apology. That's why it's called "Wabisuke". - Kira Izuru,Bleach
War is not heroic. War is not exhilarating. War is full of despair. It's dark. It's dreadful. It's a thing of sorrow and gloom. - Kira Izuru,Bleach
Farewell, warrior of the sky. I pray... you don't forgive me. - Kira Izuru,Bleach
Raise your head, Wabisuke. - Kira Izuru,Bleach
[in reference to Mizuho Asano, Keigo's sister] I owe this crazy woman. - Madarame Ikkaku,Bleach
You can't carry me AND dodge at the same time, Tetsuzaemon! - Madarame Ikkaku,Bleach
Awww maaan, and I really didn't feel like using it this early either. Better watch closely, and make sure you don't tell a soul! Bankai!! - Madarame Ikkaku,Bleach

Well, you sure have weird ways of doing things. The one who taught me how to give your name out to he whom you are about to kill also said... that it was always the last lesson he taught his students. That way, if you do end a person's life... at the very least, they will know the name of the one who slashed their mortal coil. I'm of the 11th Division, 3rd seat, Madarame Ikkaku! You're right, there's no reason for me to hear your name, because the most important thing is that you know mine. After all, it is the name of the man... who will send you to your death! - Madarame Ikkaku,Bleach

I got no intentions of becoming a captain. Becoming a captain would mean that I can't fight under Captain Zaraki. If your wish is to surpass Kuchiki Byakuya... then I just have one wish: to fight and die under that man's command. That's all. - Madarame Ikkaku,Bleach
Live well, Ichigo. Live well, age well, go bald well, and die after me. And... if you can, die smiling. - Kurosaki Isshin,Bleach

I didn't hate it as much as I said. That hollow, that is. If there's anything that I've truly hated for 20 years without thinking twice... it'd have to be the fact that I failed to save Masaki on that night. - Kurosaki Isshin,Bleach

It's one of the basics... So I will teach you. A shinigami at the rank of Captain can control the size of his zanpakuto got it? Otherwise everyone'd carry around ginormous swords... just like you. Remember this well. You can't fathom the power of your rival simply from the size of his zanpakuto. You shouldn't give lectures about Shinigami until you understand that. - Kurosaki Isshin,Bleach
[to Yuzu] Ah! It's okay, Yuzu, don't cry! Daddy will show you something really hilarious! - Kurosaki Isshin,Bleach
[to Karin] Do as your heart desires! Jump into your father's bosom! - Kurosaki Isshin,Bleach

It's not anyone's fault that Masaki died. It's just that... the woman I fell in love with... was a woman who could die protecting her son. And don't forget. You are the guy... the woman I loved gave her life to protect. - Kurosaki Isshin,Bleach
GOOD MOOOORNING ICHIGOOOOOO!!!! - Kurosaki Isshin,Bleach

We can't waste time worrying about the what-if's. Rukia's execution date has been changed to noon tomorrow. So what? If the deadline has been changed to tomorrow... I'll just have to finish today! - Kurosaki Ichigo,Bleach
The moment I came out of that hole was the moment your luck ran out! - Kurosaki Ichigo,Bleach

I see. So basically, you're a shinigami? And you came all the way from some place called Soul Society to vanquish evil spirits? Which means that monster earlier was one of those evil spirits? And it attacked that little girl? Okay, I belie- NO WAY I'LL BELIEVE THAT, DUMBASS! - Kurosaki Ichigo,Bleach
Dammit, is that how you greet your son who went out of his way to help a ghost on the way home?! - Kurosaki Ichigo,Bleach

[about his Hollow group prior to them becoming Arancar as he eats pieces of them] You sicken me. You're all just a bunch of bloody cowards. Alright, I'll eat all of you. You'll see how it feels on the next level, as a part of my own flesh. I am... I am the king! - Grimmjow Jeagerjaques,Bleach
[To Orihime] I've repaid my debt to you. Now, you're gonna accompany me on a little errand. - Grimmjow Jeagerjaques,Bleach
[to Ichigo] I don't care if you're a human, a Soul Reaper or even a Hollow! I'll crush anybody who looks down on me! And you, Kurosaki, will be the first to go! - Grimmjow Jeagerjaques,Bleach

[to Ichigo] You're a Soul Reaper and I'm a Hollow. Whichever side loses will be massacred! It's been that way for over a thousand years! Who needs any more reason than that?! Now bring it! The last man standing gets to go home alive! That's all there is to it! - Grimmjow Jeagerjaques,Bleach
[about Ulquiorra Cifer, after he takes out Ichigo] I'll teach him what happens when you steal someone else's prey. - Grimmjow Jeagerjaques,Bleach

[to Ichigo] Don't forget my name, Soul Reaper, and you better pray that you never hear it again! Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez...because the next time you hear my name, you'll be a dead man...I promise. - Grimmjow Jeagerjaques,Bleach
[as a child, to Rangiku Matsumoto] I've decided. I'm going to become a Shinigami. Become a Shinigami and change things. So that they'll end...without Rangiku having to cry. - Ichimaru Gin,Bleach

Emotions? Nope, I've got nothin' like that. I told you when we first met, didn't I? I'm a snake. With cold skin, no emotions, that slithers around searching for prey with its tongue, swallowing down whatever looks tasty. - Ichimaru Gin,Bleach
[Talking about Hueco Mundo] There isn't even water! Huh? Then how'd we have tea earlier? - Ichimaru Gin,Bleach
[Referring to Tosen] He's such a boy scout, wouldn't you agree? - Ichimaru Gin,Bleach
Oops. They found us. - Ichimaru Gin,Bleach
[To Rukia as she is taken to Sokyoku Hill] Bye Bye, Rukia chan! See 'ya at the execution grounds. - Ichimaru Gin,Bleach
If you pull your sword in a place like this, I'll just have to stop you, won't I? - Ichimaru Gin,Bleach

*about Temari* Subtle as a rhino... she might even be scarier than my mom. - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto
*about women, to his father* If women made you a better person, I wouldn't want to know what you were like before. - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto

*about girls* C'mon. You know what they're like. You can never figure them out. You never know where you could stand with them. The smallest things could put you in their bad side. Always playing little mind games with you. Trying to make you do what they want. They're just a big pain basically. - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto
When you have that kid, I'll have to protect it. So I've gotta grow up to be a cool adult too! - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto
We're not stupid enough to go out there planning to die. - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto
*to Hidan* That pathetic Lord Jashin or whatever isn't your God anymore. I am. The only one bringing down vengeance is me. - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto
*to Hidan* See, you and I have different beliefs. I believe in the Will of Fire. - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto

Ughh. Great. What's the point in setting the alarm if I'm going to wake up before it goes off? What a total waste. Now I've gotta shut it off but I don't feel like moving. But if I don't shut it off it will just keep ringing and ringing. Sigh. It makes me tired just thinking about the whole thing. Some mornings are such a drag... - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto
You would think just this once, when it was life or death, I could pull through. - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto
How many times do I have to tell you? The first move is always a feint. - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto

I never really liked Sasuke, but all the same, he's a member of the Hidden Leaf village, he's a comrade and I'll put my life on the line to help him, that's the way of our village. I know I usually seem like a pretty lazy guy, but not today. Because now, I'm responsible for your lives too. - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto
Sometimes I wish I was just a cloud, floating along. - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto
*about Ino* What a drag... I say a single thing against Sasuke, and I have to get that evil look from her eyes. - Nara Shikamaru,Naruto
Who're you calling "pig", you billboard brow?! - Ino Yamanaka,Naruto
*to Sakura* You bloomed into a beautiful flower. - Ino Yamanaka,Naruto
*talking about Naruto* I could almost fall for him. - Ino Yamanaka,Naruto
Wise words, Guy sensei! So simple but filled with such profound meaning! - Rock Lee,Naruto
The lotus of the Leaf Village blooms twice. - Rock Lee,Naruto
I want to show I can be a splendid ninja as well even if I don't have ninjutsu or genjutsu... I want to prove it to the whole world! - Rock Lee,Naruto
Sakura, please go out with me! I'll protect you with my life! - Rock Lee,Naruto
A rock thrown at a pole will not hit, but if one does not aim at the pole, it will hit! That is the law I used! - Rock Lee,Naruto
Amazing... The brilliance of the blade... the design. They're all beautiful! I want to take them all home! - Tenten,Naruto

Three members of Team Guy specializes in Close-Contact battles so I often render aid from the distance. I don't mind providing back up, but I was hoping to find new ninja tools that would enable me to fight on the front lines. - Tenten,Naruto
You're gonna fight Sasuke alone? And you think all of us are just gonna stand here and let you?! - Tenten,Naruto
Let's just say I don't like being kept in the dark! - Tenten,Naruto
I'm not running away and I'm not giving up. I will save this child. - Tenten,Naruto

I won't let that happen. You're not getting off that easy. No way! The people you and Raiga killed, they all wanted to live but you didn't leave them that choice! You decided for them! Well you don't get to decide this time, ok?! You're gonna live and you're going to take some responsibility for all those people's lives you cut short! - Tenten,Naruto
I can't stand weak and indecisive people! - Tenten,Naruto
I want to be a great and powerful ninja! To walk in the footsteps of the legendary kunoichi, Tsunade! - Tenten,Naruto
It's not because they're girls you know, Neji. It's just that those two are using kid gloves. It doesn't matter if you're a man or woman in battle. - Tenten,Naruto
*last words* When the tree leaves dance, one shall find flames. The fire's shadow will illuminate the village, and once again, tree leaves shall bud anew. - Hiruzen Sarutobi,Naruto

It is a place where every year shinobi are born, raised, grow old, fight, and die to protect their home. These people are precious to me. We share a home, we share a life, and though we may not share ties of blood, they are precious to me. They are my family. And if I do fall, you still will fail. I am only one of a long line. I carry this title in trust for those Hokage who came before and those who will come after. I am the Third Hokage! - Hiruzen Sarutobi,Naruto
I wonder...do you have it, young as you are... the Will of Fire? - Hiruzen Sarutobi,Naruto
He has combined Shadow Clone with his own invention, the Sexy Jutsu. What a foolish ninja technique...and he could probably get me with it, too. - Hiruzen Sarutobi,Naruto
I am the Fifth Hokage... You've trampled on our ancestors treasure...their dream...and you will pay the price! As the Hokage, I will put a stop to you here and now! - Tsunade,Naruto

*talking to the advisers* People like Jiraiya...and Sarutobi, and Elder Chiyo of the Sand possessed something you two sorely lack. Do you know what that is!? ...Faith! My grandfather, the First Hokage, believed in you and entrusted you with the village. Now it's your turn to believe in these children and entrust it to them! - Tsunade,Naruto
Grow up... Death comes with being a shinobi. There are times when death is hard to accept, but if you don't get over it, there's no future... - Tsunade,Naruto
*to Orochimaru about Naruto* "I will die before I let you touch him! - Tsunade,Naruto
Why am I putting my life on the line? Because now... I am the Fifth Hokage of the Village Hidden in the Leaves! - Tsunade,Naruto

Jiraiya, are you the one who taught him the Rasengan? Are you acting like a teacher by teaching him something he can't master? Don't give him any ideas! That's why this kid likes to daydream that he's going to become Hokage someday. - Tsunade,Naruto
*about to fight Naruto* One of the Legendary Sannin taking on a snot-nosed Genin... I oughta be ashamed of myself. - Tsunade,Naruto
*last words* Itachi-san... It seems that in the end... I'm not so terrible after all. - Kisame Hoshigaki,Naruto
I get stronger in direct proportion to how strong my opponent is. I do not tire, and cannot be defeated. - Kisame Hoshigaki,Naruto
*to Asuma* My massive blade, Samehada, doesn't slice... It shreds to ribbons! - Kisame Hoshigaki,Naruto

Sharks start out as eggs, but incubate and hatch in the womb. Sometimes the number of pups is less than the number of eggs that were fertilized. Do you know why? Cannibalism. The pups start eating each other within the mother's womb the moment they hatch. They start killing their siblings the moment they enter the world, viewing everything they see as nothing more than prey. As of today you and I are fellow members of Akatsuki. So be careful... of me. - Kisame Hoshigaki,Naruto

I knew that from the first time I had to kill my comrades... Kill a Kiri ninja as a Kiri ninja. What does that make me? Am I a friend or foe? What is my purpose and my position? Where do I go? Where can I go? I'm well aware that my entire life has been a one giant lie. - Kisame Hoshigaki,Naruto
*to Kakashi* I died as a human! - Zabuza Momochi,Naruto

*last words* You were always at my side, the least I can do is to be beside you at the end. I know it cannot be, but I wish I could go to where you have gone. How I wish I could join you there, Haku. - Zabuza Momochi,Naruto

I can't think of a more fitting destination for a demon ninja, can you?! I'm told there are many demons down there - of all shapes and sizes! Oh yes, I should fit right in! You, on the other hand, Gatō... Well,I fear you're in for a long and very painful eternity! - Zabuza Momochi,Naruto
Even the unremarkable Demon of the Hidden Mist can die and become a real Demon in hell! - Zabuza Momochi,Naruto
Uh uh...I won't be joining Haku. Where he's gone I cannot follow. We wouldn't be welcome where Haku's gone to. Hell's where WE'RE going, Gatō! - Zabuza Momochi,Naruto

Well? Cat got your tongue? Are you so surprised to discover that I'm human? Even shinobi are human. No matter how hard we try, we always fail to escape that simple fact. Well at least, I have failed. - Zabuza Momochi,Naruto
*to Naruto* Your words cut deep, deeper than any blade. - Zabuza Momochi,Naruto

When you've hovered between life and death so many times that it doesn't faze you, you may be called a ninja. When you've become so deadly that your profile has been entered into my bingo book, then you may have earned the title ninja. - Zabuza Momochi,Naruto
You're right. Those little people and their little dreams, why should I care about them?! I have my own dream! - Zabuza Momochi,Naruto
When I was your age, my hands were already soaked in blood... - Zabuza Momochi,Naruto

I used to always cry and give up... I made many wrong turns... But you... You helped me find the right path... I always chased after you... I wanted to catch up to you... I wanted to walk beside you all the time... I just wanted to be with you... You changed me! Your smile is what saved me! That is why I'm not afraid to die protecting you! Because... I love you... - Hinata Hyuuga,Naruto
I won't let you lay another finger on Naruto! - Hinata Hyuuga,Naruto
*to Naruto* You make mistakes... but... because of those mistakes... you get the strength to stand up to them. That's why I think you are truly strong. - Hinata Hyuuga,Naruto
*to Naruto* When I watch you, I feel strong, like I can do anything - that even I am worth something. - Hinata Hyuuga,Naruto
You're wrong, Neji... Because I can see that you are suffering more than me... You are the one who is confused and suffering inside the fate of the head and branch families. - Hinata Hyuuga,Naruto
Was I able to change myself...even a little, N-Naruto-kun? - Hinata Hyuuga,Naruto
I will never go back on my word, because that too is my ninja way! - Hinata Hyuuga,Naruto
By the way, I'm a boy. - Haku,Naruto

My name is Uzumaki Naruto. I like ramen. I hate the three minutes you have to wait while the water boils. And my dream is to one day become a Hokage. Then everyone will have to respect me at last. - Naruto Uzumaki,Naruto

Sasori...your strength came because of your soul, not in spite of it. You tried to erase it, to become a puppet yourself, but couldn't change completely. Now you've got your immortal body, but you've fallen, sunk to the level of the puppets you used to control. You were supposed to be a top class ninja puppeteer, not a worthless nobody who lets someone else pull the strings. - Kankuro,Naruto

How well or poorly we execute our ambush will have a huge impact on this war and how many casualties we suffer. If you wanna protect your friends and family, the only thing you should be thinking about is how to make this operation a success! - Kankuro,Naruto
*to Naruto* Aww, don't sweat it. Women always go weak in the knees for that cool, elite type of guy. So what can you do, am I right? - Kankuro,Naruto
Naruto... please save my little brother. - Kankuro,Naruto
I'll show you the real power of the battle puppet Crow. - Kankuro,Naruto
I can't back down when they show me no respect. - Kankuro,Naruto
*thinking about Naruto* This brat...I'm going to kill him. - Kankuro,Naruto
Growth occurs when one goes beyond one's limits. Realizing that is also part of training. - Itachi Uchiha,Naruto
*last words* Forgive me Sasuke... It ends with this. - Itachi Uchiha,Naruto
*to Kisame* Those who turn their hands against their comrades are sure to die a terrible death. Be prepared. - Itachi Uchiha,Naruto

The people of this clan are all the same. You focus on the trivial, and lose sight of what's most important. Change is impossible, in this fog of ignorance. How can we evolve when regulation is all we know? - Itachi Uchiha,Naruto
I've had enough, there's no hope left for this pathetic clan. - Itachi Uchiha,Naruto
Don't cry, Sasuke. Your big brother is here to protect you, no matter what happens. - Itachi Uchiha,Naruto

You and I are flesh and blood. I'm always going to be there for you, even if it's only as an obstacle for you to overcome. Even if you do hate me. That's what big brothers are for. - Itachi Uchiha,Naruto
*last words* Just when me and Kakashi were becoming friends... I couldn't bring myself to confess to Rin... I wish I had more time with everyone... - Obito Uchiha,Naruto
*to Kakashi* I'm about to... die... but I'll become your eye. - Obito Uchiha,Naruto
I believe the "White Fang" is a true hero! - Obito Uchiha,Naruto
*to Kakashi* I am Uchiha Obito and I will surpass you once I awaken my Sharingan! - Obito Uchiha,Naruto
I have already awakened. - Sasuke Uchiha,Naruto
I don't understand what's going on, but I'll just pretend that I do. *nods head in agreement* - Naruto Uzumaki,Naruto
*to Naruto* Finding a new me, that is the lesson you taught me. - Kabuto Yakushi,Naruto

I decided I wished to be like you as well, Naruto-kun, and for that reason...with Orochimaru-sama now intregrated into this body, I plan on finding a new "me", one stronger than Orochimaru-sama himself! - Kabuto Yakushi,Naruto
Hehehe...you can't beat me. You have no skills, unlike Sasuke. - Kabuto Yakushi,Naruto
*to Naruto* You've just thrown it all away! Dreams don't come true when you're dead! - Kabuto Yakushi,Naruto
Little kids think life is so easy. That's why they go on and on about their dreams. That's why they never give up. - Kabuto Yakushi,Naruto
Oh you look so beautiful... We're not here for a picnic you know. - Kabuto Yakushi,Naruto
Don't worry, this will be over in five seconds. - Sasuke Uchiha,Naruto
We're just some normal ninja, we don't want to see what's under your mask. - Naruto Uzumaki,Naruto

*to Naruto* Lord Jiraiya only had praise for you. He was always boasting about you, saying you were like his own grandchild. He had faith that you were the one who would inherit his will, and truly believed that you would one day be a great Hokage. Lord Jiraiya will always watch over you. Even this very minute, he's watching from somewhere. He wouldn't be happy seeing you sad like this. So...be your usual self, the one he praised so much. Don't stay depressed forever. For Lord Jiraiya himself, one of the Legendary Sannin...acknowledged you as his promising student! - Iruka Umino,Naruto
So I acted like an idiot. It was tough, has it been lonely for you Naruto, was it tough Naruto?? - Iruka Umino,Naruto

We are humans, not fish. We don't know what kind of people we truly are until the moment before our deaths. As death comes to embrace you, you will realize what you are. That's what death is, don't you think? - Itachi Uchiha,Naruto
You are weak. Why are you so weak? Because you lack... hatred. - Itachi Uchiha,Naruto
If I can't do 400 push-ups, I'll hit the dummy 800 times! If I can't hit the dummy 800 times, I'll do 2000 jump ropes! - Rock Lee,Naruto
I am the Handsome Devil of the Hidden Leaf Village! My name is Rock Lee! - Rock Lee,Naruto
Guy-sensei is the coolest! He practically GLOWS with cool! - Rock Lee,Naruto
Stop calling me Ero-sennin!! - Jiraiya,Naruto
Baka, baka, baka!! They found out I was peeking! Now my research is ruined! - Jiraiya,Naruto
The only thing that can keep a fire from dying and give it more power, is wind. - Naruto Uzumaki,Naruto
If I become as strong as you, will I really become like you? To die as a tool...that's...that's just too sad. - Naruto Uzumaki,Naruto
*last words* The Tale of Naruto Uzumaki... yes... that has a nice ring to it. - Jiraiya,Naruto
There, that ending...was a little better. The frog at the bottom of the well drifts off into the great ocean. Heh heh ...yep. Pretty damn honorable... pretty damn honorable... - Jiraiya,Naruto
*to Naruto* I think we all have to acknowledge you. Gamatatsu, Gamakichi, Sakura, Tsunade...and I... We all admit you've worked really hard. But I wonder what's pushing you forward. - Jiraiya,Naruto

Never go back on your word...and never give up. That's your ninja way...and as your mentor ... I have no business whining! Because the student's ninja way should be the master's too! Isn't that so, Naruto?! - Jiraiya,Naruto
The true measure of a shinobi is not how he lives, but how he dies. - Jiraiya,Naruto
*to Orochimaru about Sasuke* Because it's no fun to train a genius! - Jiraiya,Naruto

*to Orochimaru* You're wrong, that's not what makes a shinobi. You never did get it, a real ninja is one who endures no matter what gets thrown at him... Let me explain something to you, there is only one thing that matters if you are a shinobi, and it isn't the number of jutsu you possess. All you do need, is the guts to never give up. - Jiraiya,Naruto

*to Naruto* Even I can tell that hatred is spreading. I wanted to do something about it...but I don't know what. I believe... that someday the day will come when people truly understand one another!! If I can't find the answer, it will be up to you to do it!! - Jiraiya,Naruto

When people get hurt, they learn to hate... When people hurt others, they become hated and racked with guilt. But knowing that pain allows people to be kind. Pain allows people to grow... and how you grow is up to you. - Jiraiya,Naruto
Wherever someone thinks of you, that's where home is. - Jiraiya,Naruto
I'm not a pervert... I'm a super pervert! - Jiraiya,Naruto
Die! Just Die! You have no talent at all!! - Jiraiya,Naruto
Shut up you flat-chested bitch Tsunade! - Jiraiya,Naruto
You are the strongest enemy I have ever fought. - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
No one can determine another's destiny. - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
The heavens will not allow a pawn who can only seek victory at the cost of himself to advance... - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
*about Gai* He's so childish. He acts like a seven-year-old! - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
*about Lee and Gai* As usual, I can't keep up with their craziness. - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
Because Naruto... you saved me from the darkness. - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
All this time I've been called a genius, so I cannot lose. - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
Sasuke's out there right now, heading toward Orochimaru. We can't allow such evil to take someone from our village... that is not our way. - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
Naruto... Sometimes, your eyes are even better than mine. - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto

Father, is a person's destiny a thing like a cloud flowing with an inescapable flow? Or can a person choose the flow he wishes... I still don't know the answer to this. Either way the destination may be the same in the end. However by choosing to live like the latter, a person can live and strive towards a goal. And in this match I have finally understood those who have that are truly strong. Father, I have but one goal, I want to become stronger... Enough not to lose to anyone... That's how I feel. Father, the birds are flying freely today... They look so happy. - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
There's no method but death to escape this horrible curse. - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
The curse represents a mark of the bird in a cage... It is... the symbol of being tied down to an inescapable destiny. - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto

*to Naruto* These eyes of mine show me many things. One thing they've shown me...people's limitations are set, fixed, and unchangeable. Only a fool wastes his time trying to become something he can never be! - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
Do you understand now? You have no way of beating me! - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
Once a failure, always a failure. You can't change that. - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
Right now, Sasuke is in the darkness. The only one who can save him is you, Naruto. - Neji Hyuuga,Naruto
Try it trash! I'll return the pain a thousand times over! - Naruto Uzumaki,Naruto
I am, Jiraiya, the epitome of manliness! I shall fall for no woman's wiles! When you're me, you only need to flash that sexiness to have women fall at your feet. - Jiraiya,Naruto
WHAT?! Why wasn't he affected by my sexiness?! - Ino Yamanaka,Naruto
SHIKAMARU! Beat her up with a 16 HIT COMBO! - Ino Yamanaka,Naruto
There's no meaning to a flower unless it blooms. - Ino Yamanaka,Naruto
A soul needs a purpose to live...and so I concluded that my purpose was to kill everyone besides myself. I felt alive... - Gaara,Naruto
I fight for my sake only and live to love no one but myself. - Gaara,Naruto
*young Gaara attempts to slash his wrist* It's no use, the sand gets in the way. - Gaara,Naruto
The concept of hope is nothing more than giving up. A word that holds no true meaning. - Madara Uchiha,Naruto
The Uchiha is a clan destined for revenge... - Madara Uchiha,Naruto
*to Minato, about his reason for attacking Konoha* Oh, you know...it's fun, it's part of my plan...to start a war...to bring peace... - Madara Uchiha,Naruto
It will be a new world... A world of truth, not lies. - Madara Uchiha,Naruto
When a man learns to love, he must bear the risk of hatred. - Madara Uchiha,Naruto
*to Sasuke* No matter how far Orochimaru fell, he still loved him... Now I know how the Third Hokage felt. - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto
*to Sakumo* Regardless of what happened, you did the best you could. I understand that now...you broke the rules for all our sakes - I'm proud of you now... - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto
*to Pain* The people from this village are different from your average village. Even if it means dying, there's not a single one of us, who would sell out a comrade. - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto
*to Naruto* You've become as strong...if not stronger than me. - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto
Like the fate of the two who founded the village of Konoha... Naruto and Sasuke...your fates are like theirs. - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto
This place makes me think about the mistakes I've made in the past... and I've made a lot. - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto
*to Orochimaru* I don't care if you are one of the legendary Sannin, the great shinobi of legend, I swear take one more step towards Sasuke and one of us will die here! - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto

I'm Kakashi Hatake. Things I like and things I hate...I don't feel like telling you that. My dreams for the future...never really thought about it. As for my hobbies...I have lots of hobbies. - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto

A genius, huh? What does that mean? "Genius"? So I was not born with a whole lot of natural talent, not gifted like Neji ...but I work hard and I never give up! That is my gift, that is my ninja way! - Rock Lee,Naruto

*to Sasuke* I refuse...to let this happen! I am Orochimaru! I am immortal! I will not die here! Destined to discover the true meaning behind everything! Destined to take control of everything in this world!! - Orochimaru,Naruto
When there is a true desire in the heart and that desire is strong... That is when he finds real strength that even he did not know he had! - Orochimaru,Naruto
Everything will be mine. - Orochimaru,Naruto
*about Sasuke* When I watch this boy, I look back to the time I was called a genius, and think how ridiculous it was. - Orochimaru,Naruto
*to Sasuke* How impressive. A thousand foes stand before you and you don't even bat an eyelid. - Orochimaru,Naruto
*talking about Naruto* This child... intrigues me to no end! - Orochimaru,Naruto
Hate only gives birth to even more hate. - Orochimaru,Naruto

I want to obtain all the jutsu and gain a true understanding of everything in this world. The first one to mix blue and yellow called the new color "green". I want to do something similar to that. If blue is the chakra, then yellow is the seal, and green is the jutsu... Just as there is no end to the variety of colors, there are so many thousands...tens of thousands of jutsu in the world as well. But in order to obtain every possible jutsu and truth, it would require an eternity. Only one who understands everything after spending such time on this can be fittingly called the Ultimate Being. - Orochimaru,Naruto
*to Kabuto, talking about Tsunade) The best medicines always taste bitter. - Orochimaru,Naruto
There probably isn't any meaning in life. Perhaps you can find something interesting to do while you are alive. Like how you found that flower. Like how I found you. - Orochimaru,Naruto

Naruto's here because he's made up his mind. My resolve is nothing compared to his now! I'm supposed to be a ninja, but all I've ever done is lean on him and cry... I was supposed to change that... I came here and I thought I was ready. But I can't do anything... I can't say anything. The only thing that remains for me...is to believe in them! - Sakura Haruno,Naruto
*about killing Sasuke* I... Sasuke... I... I thought I could do this... - Sakura Haruno,Naruto

I'm the one who made Naruto suffer the most... I've just been getting it wrong. Just been messing it up... I don't want to get it wrong anymore...don't want to screw it up anymore. - Sakura Haruno,Naruto
*talking to Yamato* Same as always... I can only do the dumbest of things for Naruto... - Sakura Haruno,Naruto
A smile is the easiest way out of a difficult situation. - Sakura Haruno,Naruto

*to Sasuke* I... I love you with all my heart!.. If you were to stay here with me, there would be no regrets...because every day we'd do something fun, we'd be happy I swear..! I would do anything for you! So...please, just stay with me! - Sakura Haruno,Naruto

I've always considered myself to be a true ninja...but those were just empty words, because Sasuke and Naruto were always in the lead! But now it's my turn to take the lead, and all of you can watch me from the background! - Sakura Haruno,Naruto
*to Ino* Didn't you know? Women have to be strong in order to survive! - Sakura Haruno,Naruto
All I've been doing is watching you two from behind... Now, get a good look at MY back! - Sakura Haruno,Naruto

*talking to Sasuke* On that day, you taught me that solitude is painful! I understand that so well right now. I have family, and I have friends but if you're gone... To me... It will be the same as being alone. - Sakura Haruno,Naruto
In the ninja world, those who break the rules are scum, that's true, but those who abandon their friends are worse than scum. - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto
I won't allow my comrades to die. I'll protect you with my life. Trust me. - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto
The next generation will always surpass the previous one. It's one of the never-ending cycles in life. - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto
*making excuses for being late, as usual* Hello students, today I got lost on the road of life. - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto
*making excuses for being late, as usual* A cute girl stopped me on the way, so I danced. - Hatake Kakashi,Naruto
